doc: Read a field of cells as numbers, place values in it, step it, return to a frame, ask what would be, and who changed a cell.

tools.name: field.observe
tools.description: The frame, the steps run, the state's hash, the field's shape, and each channel of a region as numbers: least, most, sum, cells not zero

region.description: [x, y, width, height] in cells (the whole field when none is given)

budget.description: the most bytes of answer: channels are left out from the last, and `more` says how many

tools.name: field.cells
tools.description: One channel's values in a region, row by row; at most 4096 cells a request

tools.name: field.place
tools.description: Sets one channel to a value over a region; a frame of its own, recorded like a step
tools.undo: field.seek to the frame before it

tools.name: field.step
tools.description: Runs the program a number of steps over the field: the tiles awake (what is at rest sleeps, the result the same); answers where the field is and how many of its tiles sleep
tools.undo: field.seek to the frame it began at

steps.description: how many (1 when none is given)

tools.name: field.seek
tools.description: Returns to a frame within the history kept; what is run from there is a new branch
tools.undo: none within the field: what came after the frame is another branch's

tools.name: field.branch
tools.description: What would be: the field some steps ahead, a value placed first when one is given, observed as field.observe does; the field itself untouched

steps.description: how far ahead (1 when none is given)

channel.description: with `value` and `place`: placed before the steps

region.description: the region observed (the whole field when none is given)

tools.name: field.explain
tools.description: Why a cell holds what it holds, as far as the field knows: its values, the edits on record that cover it — what was written, at which frame, by whom — the latest first, and what the program changed of it in the last step

tasks.name: read-the-field
tasks.summary: Read the field's channels in brief, then one channel's cells in a region

tasks.name: place-step-and-look
tasks.summary: Place a value, step the rules, and read what became of it

tasks.name: ask-what-would-be
tasks.summary: See the field some steps ahead with a value placed first, the field itself untouched

tasks.name: ask-who-changed-a-cell
tasks.summary: Place a value and ask who changed a cell, and what the last step did to it
